svg.title: Per-tenant retrieval instructions on one shared managed knowledge base
svg.desc: Tenant applications call a backend that picks a per-tenant instruction version and metadata filter, then calls AgenticRetrieveStream on one shared managed knowledge base. The filter limits what each tenant retrieves, an optional AWS Identity and Access Management (IAM) tag check limits which instruction a tenant can apply, and the trace and AWS CloudTrail record the applied version.
